about_the_game:
How do you solve a mystery when every truth rewrites the world around you?

A young woman disappears in a remote coastal town, echoing the unsolved case of your own sister. As detective Alex Hart, you return home chasing answers… and running from memories you can’t trust.

What begins as straightforward missing-person case spirals into a psychological descent shaped entirely by the clues you uncover. Every small discovery can fracture relationships, shift the nature of reality, or pull you into one of four radically different storylines—each exposing a separate truth about what really happened.
Some are grounded in human cruelty.
Some reshape the rules of memory and identity.
And one may cost you everything.

This is not a story that branches at the end.
It is a story that metamorphoses based on the choices you make along the way.

Features

Four truths. Four worlds. One shattered reality.

Your investigation doesn’t just change its ending—it changes its entire genre.
Each of the four major routes offers a complete, standalone storyline with its own themes, tone, and revelations. What feels like a grounded crime thriller may transform into psychological horror, a looping existential puzzle, or a morally conflicted conspiracy.

Clues that truly matter

Choices aren’t cosmetic.
Every clue you uncover (or miss) reconfigures the path ahead: who you trust, who survives, and what the world even is. Some truths remain forever hidden unless you approach the case from a completely different angle.

Relationships that bend and break

The people you meet aren’t archetypes.
Their loyalties bend under pressure.
Their morality twists with your decisions.
And your relationships can become your greatest strength… or the reason someone dies.

Romance woven into the mystery

Desire and danger are inseparable.
Love can anchor you, blind you, or break you. And in some truths, it might be the only thing keeping you sane.

Face your past, or let it consume the case

Alex’s fractured past isn’t just backstory, it’s a force you must confront.
Your choices determine whether you face your trauma, bury it, or let it reshape the case in ways you never expected.

High replayability: see what you were never meant to see

Across 15–20 hours, each route reveals new layers, hidden clues, and alternate interpretations of earlier scenes.
No single playthrough contains “the real story.”
Only by exploring multiple truths will the full picture—and the consequences—come into focus.

Full multilingual release

Launched in seven fully localized languages: English, French, Russian, Latin American Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Traditional Chinese, and Turkish—each carefully adapted for emotional tone and natural dialogue.

In this town, the truth is not a single answer.
It’s a choice.
And every choice demands a sacrifice.

Will you find her…
or lose yourself in the truths you were never meant to see?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes, suggestive content, and emotional intensity, including trauma, violence, and psychological manipulation. All intimate content is consensual and integral to the narrative. Recommended for mature audiences (17+) only.
